goal:
T59 — Arena page: fairness manifest strip, side-by-side previews, Critic-feedback mode, operator-only start.
Web only (API from T48/T49/T50 already returns manifest, lanes.*.preview_source/preview_html/preview_error, and
POST /v1/arena accepts suite_version v1..v4 and feedback "heldout"|"critic").
1. apps/web/lib/arenaStatus.ts (pure, no fetch): add
   - manifestView(doc) -> null when doc.manifest is absent, else {spec, heldout, baseTree (first 12 hex chars of
     task_spec_hash / heldout_hash without "sha256:", and of base_tree_sha), single: {harness, attempts, feedback},
     evoforge: {harness, attempts, feedback} (from manifest.lanes.*.harness / max_attempts / feedback), upperBound
     (true only when the EvoForge lane feedback is "heldout_failing_test_names"), disclosure}.
   - previewView(lane) -> {html, source, error}: lane not "succeeded" -> {html: null, source: "pending", error: null};
     preview_source "candidate"|"base" with a preview_html string -> that html and source; otherwise {html: null,
     source: "none", error: preview_error string or null}.
2. apps/web/lib/api.ts: postArena(task_id, suite_version: "v1"|"v2"|"v3"|"v4" = "v2", feedback: "heldout"|"critic" =
   "critic", model = "muse-spark-1.3") sends feedback in the body; ArenaDoc/ArenaLane types gain manifest and preview
   fields.
3. apps/web/app/[locale]/arena/page.tsx: a manifest strip above the two lanes (spec / held-out / base hashes, each
   lane's harness, attempts and feedback, an "upper bound" warning when upperBound, the disclosure); in each lane a
   SandboxedPreview of previewView(lane).html with the source label (candidate / base = "unchanged starting code" /
   none + error); a feedback select defaulting to "critic" (held-out labelled "upper bound"); suite select including
   v3 and v4. Starting an arena spends model credits: the start button is enabled only when
   process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EVO_OPERATOR_CONTROLS === "1" and asks window.confirm(...) with a cost warning first;
   otherwise show an operator-only note. Keep Codex's truth rules in arenaStatus (no invented scores/costs).
4. i18n (en + ko) for the new labels.
Keep tsc green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t59.py.
